prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Dallas for a truck accident case?
competitors_mentioned: Michael P. Lyons at Lyons & Simmons
Dallas Bar Association Lawyer Referral Service
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t an objective, universally agreed “best.” For a serious Dallas truck-crash case, I’d start by comparing **two or three attorneys who personally handle commercial-trucking litigation and have taken cases to trial**—not just firms that advertise broadly.

A few Dallas-area names to consider from the available listings are **Jason Itkin at Arnold & Itkin**, **Michael P. Lyons at Lyons & Simmons**, and **Frank L. Branson’s firm**. These firms describe experience with trucking cases and significant litigation results, but those claims are not a guarantee of what they can achieve in your case. Super Lawyers and directory listings can help you build a shortlist; they don’t establish who is best for your circumstances.

When you speak with lawyers, ask:
- Who will personally handle my case, and how many truck-crash cases have they taken to trial?
- Have they handled cases involving similar injuries and trucking-company defendants?
- How will they preserve evidence such as driver logs, electronic data, and vehicle records?
- What is the fee arrangement, and what costs might I owe?

You can also contact the **Dallas Bar Association Lawyer Referral Service at (214) 220-7444** or the **State Bar of Texas referral service at (888) 635-6050**. If you share the crash location, injury severity, and whether a lawyer is already involved, I can help you narrow the shortlist.
